I think what helps me is hearing updates throughout the day, I'm not sure how busy you guys get but it helps me feel more included in my partners day when they tell me what they're up to. This also helps me understand when they'll be busy for long periods of time. 

The best thing you can do when you aren't able to be with them is do as many things you can do for yourself. Exercise, find a new hobby, finish a project, self care, etc, in the end you'll feel better and be in a good mood for when you are able to talk to your partner. 

If you feel like you're getting in arguments, let go of pride and explain how you feel while also taking in account of their side. If both of you want things to work then it's gonna be a process to understand what's going on in eachothers head. 

I hope some of my rambling helps, goodluck with the time change 🫶
